name: dsh-settings-ui
description: A unified settings-page UI kit + floating-panel kit for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Exposes the ctx.settingsUi service - themed primitives, declarative forms, a settings state machine (fenced route or official settingsScope) and overlay/Panel APIs - so plugins get a polished settings surface without hand-rolling their own UI.
